content_of_post_to_comment: This semester, I’ll be teaching hundreds of undergrads how to spot health misinformation online. What’s the one thing you’d want to tell a fresh-faced 18-year-olds about how to tell truth from fiction?
comment: The hardest misinformation to spot may be the kind that uses accurate facts selectively. Teaching source-checking matters, but teaching students to notice missing context might be the deeper skill.
